name: Holmarc Opto-Mechatronics Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 1993, Holmarc Opto-Mechatronics Ltd manufactures scientific 
and engineering instruments for research, industry, and education[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
HOML, an ISO 9001-2015 certified company, manufactures a wide range of scientific and engineering instruments for research, industry, and education. Their products include spectroscopy, microscopy, holography, and thin film technologies. HOML supports the scientific community with its expertise in optics, mechanics, electronics, and software development.
